description: Web admin UI for the new api-node capabilities from FEAT-001 (depends on FEAT-001 endpoints): (Issue 1/4) image field + one-click product picker in AdminNotify; (Issue 3) a Notification History admin tab + route reading GET /api/admin/notifications; (Issue 8) an App Update card in AdminSettings reading GET /api/version and writing POST /api/admin/version; (Issue 7) point AdminDashboard summary cards at GET /api/admin/stats with a graceful fallback. AdminEarnings is intentionally LEFT intact (its CSV/day-drill needs per-line-item detail the aggregate does not carry). All changes are in the web package; verified by `npm run build`.
steps: In web/src/lib/admin.ts: extend sendBroadcast(target, title, body, link?, image?) to POST image too; add fetchNotifications(params: { userId?, productId?, limit?, cursor? }) -> GET /api/admin/notifications, fetchAdminStats() -> GET /api/admin/stats, fetchAppVersion() -> GET /api/version, saveAppVersion(payload) -> POST /api/admin/version. Reuse the existing uploadBannerImage(dataUri) for push image uploads (it already returns a /api/uploads/banners/... URL).

Issue 1/4 — in web/src/pages/admin/AdminNotify.tsx: add an image URL text field plus an 'upload image' control that calls uploadBannerImage and fills the field; add an optional product <select> populated from useProducts() that, on pick, sets link to `/product/<id>` and auto-fills the image field from that product's image. Pass image + link through sendBroadcast. Keep the existing emoji/preview UI and the bulkPushEnabled feature gate.

Issue 3 — add web/src/pages/admin/AdminNotifications.tsx: a table listing sent notifications (title, type, target, success/failure counts, created_at, product/order link) with per-user (userId) and per-product (productId) filter inputs, calling fetchNotifications and supporting the limit/cursor paging. Register the tab in ADMIN_TABS in web/src/pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx (icon e.g. 🗂️, label 'Notification Log', path 'notify-log', key 'ads') and add <Route path="notify-log" element={<AdminNotifications />} /> under the /admin route tree in web/src/App.tsx (mirror the existing 'notify' route; add the import).

Issue 8 — in web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx: add a new sub to the SUBS array (e.g. { key: 'appupdate', label: '📲 App Update' }) and an AppUpdateSettings component that loads current values via fetchAppVersion() and saves via saveAppVersion() the fields version_code, version_name, url, message, force_update (checkbox). Use the existing field/input styles and showToast on success/error.

Issue 7 — in web/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboard.tsx: fetch GET /api/admin/stats via fetchAdminStats() and render the summary cards (today/month/all-time revenue, status breakdown, top products, stock health) from it; if the stats call errors, FALL BACK to the current client-side computation from useAdminOrders() so the dashboard never breaks. Do NOT modify AdminEarnings.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: `cd web && npm install && npm run build` succeeds (tsc -b + vite build, no type errors).
AdminNotify can attach an image (URL or upload) and a product that sets link=/product/<id> and auto-fills the image; image+link reach sendBroadcast.
A 'Notification Log' tab appears in ADMIN_TABS and /admin/notify-log renders AdminNotifications with user/product filters.
AdminSettings shows an App Update card that reads current version values and writes them via POST /api/admin/version.
AdminDashboard summary cards are driven by /api/admin/stats, with a working fallback to client-side computation on error.

DONE. `cd web && npm install && npm run build` is GREEN (tsc -b + vite build, no type errors; only the pre-existing advisory >500kB chunk-size warning). AdminEarnings.tsx was NOT touched.

== IMPORTANT envelope note for later steps/reviewers ==
The api-node `ok(res, payload)` helper SPREADS the payload at the TOP LEVEL ({ success: true, ...payload }) — it does NOT nest under `data`. (FEAT-001's findings described a `{ success, data }` wrapper, but the real util/http.ts spreads.) So the web lib reads fields directly off `res.data`:
- fetchAdminStats(): res.data.revenue{today,month,allTime}, res.data.deliveredOrders, res.data.totalOrders, res.data.statusCounts, res.data.topProducts[{productId,name,quantity}], res.data.outOfStock.
- fetchNotifications(): res.data.notifications[], res.data.nextCursor.
- fetchAppVersion()/saveAppVersion(): res.data.{versionCode,versionName,url,message,forceUpdate,assetVersion}.

== What was built (all in web/) ==
- web/src/lib/admin.ts: sendBroadcast() now takes optional `image` (5th arg) and POSTs it. Added fetchNotifications({userId,productId,limit,cursor}) -> GET /api/admin/notifications; fetchAdminStats() -> GET /api/admin/stats; fetchAppVersion() -> GET /api/version; saveAppVersion({version_code,version_name,url,message,force_update}) -> POST /api/admin/version. New exported types: AdminNotification, NotificationPage, AdminStats, AppVersion.
- web/src/pages/admin/AdminNotify.tsx: added Image URL field + 'Upload image' button (reuses uploadBannerImage via FileReader data-URI) + a Product <select> (from useProducts()) that on pick sets link=/product/<id> and auto-fills image from product.image. image+link flow through sendBroadcast; preview now renders the image. bulkPushEnabled gate + emoji/preview UI preserved.
- web/src/pages/admin/AdminNotifications.tsx (NEW): 'Notification Log' table (title/body, type, target, link-or-product, success, fail, sent-by, when) with User ID + Product ID filter inputs and keyset 'Load more' paging via nextCursor.
- web/src/pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx: ADMIN_TABS gained { path:'notify-log', key:'ads', icon:'🗂️', label:'Notification Log' }.
- web/src/App.tsx: added import + <Route path="notify-log" element={<AdminNotifications />} /> under /admin.
- web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx: new SUB { key:'appupdate', label:'📲 App Update' } + AppUpdateSettings component (loads fetchAppVersion, saves saveAppVersion; fields version_code/version_name/url/message/force_update with validation + showToast).
- web/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboard.tsx: summary cards now driven by fetchAdminStats() (react-query, retry:false, staleTime 30s) for revenue(today/month/allTime), delivered/total order counts, status breakdown, top products, and out-of-stock; on stats error it transparently FALLS BACK to the existing client-side computation from useAdminOrders(). Pending-pipeline + recent-orders + registered-users/products/categories cards still come from the existing client data.

NOTE for FEAT-003/mobile: topProducts.name may be empty if the order item JSON lacked a name; the dashboard shows `#<productId>` in that case.
